stories.headline: 85-year-old waited over 16 hours after a fall
stories.body: MS Paul Davies raised the west Wales case in the Senedd on 10 November and asked for a ministerial statement. Welsh hours lost to handover delays fell from 265,000 to 184,000 last year, but remain over three times the 2016–17 level.
stories.why: Handover delays still hold crews at hospital while older fallers wait at home.

stories.headline: NI ambulance chief: "One attack is one too many"
stories.body: Following the assault at Altnagelvin Hospital, NIAS chief executive Mark Cochrane has appealed for abuse of paramedics to stop. Hundreds of incidents have been recorded this year alone.
stories.why: Violence against crews is still far too common. Report every incident, however minor.

stories.headline: RCEM: fix flow and beds, not just ED funding
stories.body: The Royal College of Emergency Medicine says overcrowding and corridor care stem from a lack of beds and alternatives to admission. About 13,000 beds are taken by patients who don't need to be there.
stories.why: Hospital flow is the root of the handover delays crews face every shift.

stories.headline: HCPC report on regulating advanced practice
stories.body: Commissioned by NHS England, the HCPC and the osteopathy regulator have published findings on how registrants, managers and leaders understand regulation at advanced levels of practice, and where more clarity is needed.
stories.why: Worth a read if advanced paramedic practice is part of your career plans.

stories.headline: NWAS HART paramedic wins treble swimming gold
stories.body: NWAS HART paramedic Carl Barkley won three golds and a silver at the Great British Masters Swimming Championships.
stories.why: A reminder that life outside the job matters. Congratulations, Carl.
